{"reason": "All 8 shown failures are demand-forecast-error labeled 'unknown': market-mismatch=#t rows have no forecast-bias, and bias rows (0.065-0.081) fall under the 0.1 cutoff. Broadening the forecast branch to fire on market-signal-mismatch and lowering the bias threshold to 0.06 covers them (~1.33M) without touching the supplier-delay rules.", "source": "(define (claim-root-cause expedite-event)
  (cond
    ((and (edi-increase? expedite-event)
          (supplier-lead-time-miss? expedite-event))
     'supplier-delay)
    ((or (market-signal-mismatch? expedite-event)
         (and (forecast-bias? expedite-event)
              (> (bias-amount expedite-event) 0.06)))
     'demand-forecast-error)
    (else 'unknown)))"}
